verdict.rationale: Scheduling user-defined recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a billing and monetization platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such capability. Lago automatically invoices on plan cycles (monthly or yearly), but that is built-in billing behavior, an adjacent feature rather than a way for users to schedule their own jobs. The Dunning Agent and the AI agent are described without any recurring-schedule capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
